newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu associate named Africa-Israel chairman.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu associate named Africa-Israel chairman.

text.p: Izzi Tapuchi, a close associate of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, was appointed chairman of Africa Israel Investments, one of Israel's leading conglomerates, the company said.
Tapuchi, an accountant, serves as Treasurer of Netanyahu's Likud party and is close to the prime minister, a party spokeswoman said.
The company said its board of directors confirmed Tapuchi as chairman.
Africa Israel is a subsidiary of government-controlled Bank Leumi, which must reduce its stake to 25 percent to comply with Israeli law.
Leumi currently owns 65 percent of the voting rights in Africa Israel, which has interests in insurance, construction and hotels.
The insurance holdings will be spun off separately and Leumi has issued a tender for the sale of a controlling stake in the remaining part of Africa Israel.
